issue.title: Fix reindex with a remote source on a version before 2.0.0

labels.name: :Distributed/CRUD
labels.description: A catch all label for issues around indexing, updating and getting a doc by id. Not search.

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Discussed in https://discuss.elastic.co/t/5-3-0-breaks--reindex/80388 and https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/22931#issuecomment-290093349

This commit https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/commit/7520a107bee67099338813728147d2aee25ed240#diff-0c925d1f41390dd5d7dd09b6ff5d51d1 in master and v5.3 breaks `reindex from remote` when the source is on a version before 2.0.0. The `scroll_id` is always extracted from a plain text body in ES 1.7 (and before) and does not accept the JSON version that appears in 2.0.0.
This change checks the version of the remote cluster and builds the scroll_id in the body depending on the remote version.

body:
> versions of Elasticsearch prior to 5.0 don't know how to spit out pidfiles

Do you mean port files?  I had thought we had those in 2.x, but looking back you are right, it was not until 5.0. However, we could still have a fixture to start those older versions, we would probably want to explicitly pass in a randomly generated port (from a range). And we would need to have different cluster setup tasks, since both we won't be able to look for the ports files, and even configuration like how we pass command line args, or how we install plugins, is different.

Yes, I was thinking that older version of ES would be an independent
fixture and we'd feed it a port. We could check the logs for bind errors.
Or other things to make reasonably sure we don't get them.

issue.body:
reindex_from_remote was using `TimeValue#toString` to generate the
scroll timeout which is bad because that generates fractional
time values that are useful for people but bad for Elasticsearch
which doesn't like to parse them. This switches it to using
`TimeValue#getStringRep` which spits out whole time values.

Closes to #23945

Makes #23828 even more desirable.

Adds tests for reindex-from-remote for the latest 2.4, 1.7, and
0.90 releases. 2.4 and 1.7 are fairly popular versions but 0.90
is a point of pride.

This fixes any issues those tests revealed.

Closes #23828
